claims.assertion: Anéeka says dry pods support short immersions; wet pods sustain suspended bodies for years or decades, with fluid supplying nutrients.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She knows no cases lasting thousands of years.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says pods maintain the body while computers divert sensory attention by frequencies; electrical stimulation prevents muscle atrophy.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: Immersion can also work without a pod.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says pod failure or danger wakes the user; immersion users return to their original bodies and retain most immersion memories.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
